description: REMARK Toolbox is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by OFFIS - Institute for Information Technology; Oldenburg, Constructor University; Bremen. The REMARK toolbox is a simulation-based tool to evaluate reactive power market designs in the German context. It enables network operators to compare market outcomes with alternative network investments, predict bidding behavior and assess impacts on reactive power and spot markets. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Agent-based simulation, Agent-based modeling, Co-simulation. Time resolution: 15 min. Spatial resolution: regions. Software: mosaik, mango agents. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
